name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  intro x
  simp only [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, List.mem_append]
  induction post <;> dsimp only [substOld]
  case' app => split <;> try split
  all_goals
    simp only [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.mem_append]
    grind only

name: CallElimCorrect.extractedOldExprInVars
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  intro h
  clear h
  apply List.Sublist.subset
  induction post <;>
    repeat' first
    | assumption
    | apply List.nil_sublist
    | apply List.Sublist.append
    | apply List.Sublist.refl

name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  have hl := UpdateStatesLength hu
  have hl' := InitStatesLength hi
  refine ⟨_, rfl,
    updatedStatesInit hl' (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined hi) hu) (InitStatesNodup hi), ?_⟩
  rewrite [InitStatesUpdated hi, UpdateStatesUpdated hu]
  unfold updatedStates
  rewrite [updatedStatesComm]
  · exact updatedStatesUpdate hl (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' hu))
  · rewrite [List.unzip_zip hl, List.unzip_zip hl']
    intro k hk hk'
    simpa [InitStatesNotDefined hi k hk'] using UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x
  refine (inner_self_eq_zero' (𝕜 := ℝ)).mp
    (le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt fun hp => ?_) real_inner_self_nonneg')
  have hc := Continuous.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (fun _ => f x) hf continuous_const
  obtain ⟨φ, hs, hk, hd, hn, hφ⟩ := exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset (n := ⊤)
    (hc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (Ioi_mem_nhds hp))
  have hz := hg (fun y => φ y • f x)
    (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨hd, hk⟩ contDiff_const)
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at hz
  apply hz.not_gt
  refine (hd.continuous.fun_mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
    hk.mul_right (fun y => mul_nonneg_iff_pos_imp_nonneg.mpr
      ⟨fun hy => (hs (subset_tsupport _ hy.ne')).le, fun _ => (hn ⟨y, rfl⟩).1⟩)
    (mul_ne_zero (hφ.trans_ne one_ne_zero) hp.ne')

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hEs (j : Fin d) : ContDiff ℝ 2 (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) :=
    electricField_apply_contDiff_space (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t
  have hEd (j k : Fin d) := Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hB (j : Fin d) : ContDiff ℝ 2 ↿(fun s y => A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s y (j, i)) :=
    magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) _
  have hBt (j : Fin d) := Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j) (hB j) x t
  have hs := DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun j _ => hBt j)
  have hJt := LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time
    (c := 𝓕.c) (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) x i t
  have hg := congrArg (fun f : Space d → ℝ => fderiv ℝ f x (Space.basis i))
    (funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
  unfold Space.div at hg
  rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => hEd j j x)] at hg
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, fderiv_mul_const
    (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) t x),
    _root_.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis] at hg
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1]
    change fun s => ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) s
    enter [s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
      (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) x), time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  rw [Time.deriv_eq,
    fderiv_fun_sub (hs.const_mul _) (hJt.const_mul _),
    fderiv_const_mul hs, fderiv_const_mul hJt, fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => hBt j)]
  simp only [_root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, _root_.sum_apply, ← Time.deriv_eq]
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, 2, 2, j]
    rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (hB j)]
    simp only [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl))]
    rw [Space.fun_deriv_sub _ _ (hEd i j) (hEd j i), Space.deriv_commute _ (hEs j)]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hg, FreeSpace.c_sq, mul_comm 𝓕.ε₀ 𝓕.μ₀]
  simp only [mul_sub, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev, one_mul, mul_assoc,
    inv_mul_cancel_left₀ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero]

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  change ((mulLinearMap ∘ₗ mulLinearMap.flip c).compr₂
      (ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ timeOrderF)) a b =
    (mulLinearMap.compr₂ (ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ mulLinearMap c ∘ₗ timeOrderF)) a b
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂
    (LinearMap.ext_basis ofCrAnListFBasis ofCrAnListFBasis fun φs' φs => ?_) a b
  change ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListFBasis φs' * c * ofCrAnListFBasis φs) =
    ι (c * 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListFBasis φs' * ofCrAnListFBasis φs))
  simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul]
  let l1 :=
    List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ c) (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φs)) ++
    List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs'
  let l2 :=
    List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs ++
    List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
      (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φs))
  have hs (l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) (h : ∀ c ∈ l,
      crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) :
      crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ l ++ φs) = l1 ++ l ++ l2 := by
    exact (insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' l φs h).trans
      (List.append_assoc _ _ _)
  have h12 := hs [φ, ψ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
  have h21 := hs [ψ, φ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
  have h0 := hs [] (by simp)
  simp only [List.append_nil] at h0
  have hc := superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF [φ] [ψ]
  simp only [ofCrAnListF_singleton, List.singleton_append] at hc
  trans crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
    (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι c * ι (ofCrAnListF l2))
  all_goals dsimp only [c]
  · conv_lhs =>
      rw [hc]
      simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
        ← ofCrAnListF_append, map_sub, map_smul, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, h12, h21]
    simp only [hc, ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, map_sub, map_smul,
      mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, smul_sub]
    simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append,
      crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
    rw [smul_comm]
  · rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ),
      mul_assoc, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← h0]
    simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
    by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
    · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ hq.symm,
        ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
      simp only [map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
    · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var | sub => grind
  case abs | tabs => left; constructor; assumption
  case' app ih ih_r | tapp ih | let' ih _ | inl ih | inr ih | case ih _ _ => cases lc
  all_goals rcases ih rfl ‹_› with val | ⟨_, red⟩
  case' app.inl =>
    rcases ih_r rfl ‹_› with vr | ⟨_, hr⟩
    case' inl => obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := canonical_form_abs val ‹_›
  case' tapp.inl => obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := canonical_form_tabs val ‹_›
  case' case.inl => obtain ⟨_, rfl | rfl⟩ := canonical_form_sum val ‹_› <;> cases val
  solve_by_elim* (maxDepth := 10) only [*, Or.inl, Or.inr, Exists.intro, Red.abs, Red.appᵣ, Red.tabs, Red.let_body, Red.case_inl, Red.case_inr]

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  all_goals cases h₂
  case' par.red_I | par.red_K | par.red_S => apply symm
  case red_I.par | par.red_I =>
    obtain rfl := I_irreducible _ (by assumption)
    exact ⟨_, by assumption, .red_I _⟩
  case red_K.par | par.red_K =>
    obtain ⟨a', h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ (by assumption)
    exact ⟨_, h, .red_K ..⟩
  case red_S.par | par.red_S =>
    obtain ⟨a', b', ha, hb, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ (by assumption)
    exact ⟨_, .par (.par ha (by assumption)) (.par hb (by assumption)), .red_S ..⟩
  case par.par ha hb iha ihb a' b' ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨a', h, h'⟩ := iha ha'
    obtain ⟨b', k, k'⟩ := ihb hb'
    exact ⟨_, .par h k, .par h' k'⟩
  all_goals exact ⟨_, .refl _, by constructor <;> assumption⟩

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  exists ChoiceBisim, ChoiceBisim.choice h
  intro a b hr μ
  constructor <;> intro s ht <;> rcases hr with h | h
  all_goals try (case' choice => cases ht)
  all_goals
    first
    | exact ⟨s, .choiceR ‹_›, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl s)⟩
    | obtain ⟨t, ht, hh⟩ := (by first | exact h.follow_fst ‹_› | exact h.follow_snd ‹_›)
      refine ⟨t, ?_, .bisim hh⟩
      first | exact ht | exact .choiceL ht

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  classical
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (s :=
    (fun g : C => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) ''
      Set.univ) (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
  let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  have hcount : hammingDist f g ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    rw [ Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card', ← Fintype.card_fin (n := 2 ^ steps),
      ← Finset.card_univ, ← Finset.card_product]
    apply Finset.card_le_card_of_surjOn (fun p =>
      qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, i.isLt.trans (lt_of_add_right_lt h_ℓ_add_R_rate)⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps) (y := p.1) p.2)
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨(_, _), ?_,
      (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x _).mp rfl⟩
    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Set.mem_toFinset.mpr
      ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
  have hfw : 2 * Y.ncard ≤ 2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps)) -
      2 ^ (ℓ - (i.val + steps)) := by
    rw [show Y.ncard = _ from hg]
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mp h_fw_dist_lt)
  refine (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g g.property) 2).trans_lt
    (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le ?_))
  have h := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) hfw
  rw [Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.pow_add,
    Nat.sub_add_eq, Nat.sub_add_cancel
      (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡))),
    Nat.sub_add_eq, Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps)] at h
  exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hcount).trans (by simpa only [mul_assoc] using h)

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) := congrArg Subtype.val
    ((generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans
      (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i i.isLt (x k))).symm
  have hd : (x 1).val = 1 + (x 0).val := by
    simp only [x, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul, Submodule.coe_add,
      get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, zero_smul, zero_add]
  dsimp only [x] at hq hd
  calc
    f_i_plus_1 y = (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val := by
      simp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, f_i, P_i,
        evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
        Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, eval_comp, hq, P₀, P₁]
      rw [hd]
      ring
    _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
      simp only [evenRefinement, eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
        mul_sum, oddRefinement, ←sum_add_distrib, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
        P₀, P₁, P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, add_mul, mul_assoc]
      rfl

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  apply Nat.le_induction
  · intro u hp
    have hu : finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) = u := funext fun
      | 0 => rfl
      | 1 => rfl
    rw [← hu]
    apply hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1)
    rw [← prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq]
    simp only [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation,
      Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hp
    assumption
  · intro n hn ih u hp
    apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA _ u e
    apply h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ n) Nat.one_le_two_pow
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le (prob_R_star_gt_threshold MC u e ?_) ?_
    · rw [← prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun]
      apply lt_of_lt_of_le hp
      apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
      intro r hr
      rw [multilinearCombine_recursive_form u] at hr
      exact hr
    · apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
      intro r hr
      exact correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor MC ih u ⟨r, hr⟩

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  let f := fun n => (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3))
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, heq⟩ :=
    (Set.finite_Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T)).exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem
      (f := f) (by intro n; simp only [mem_Icc, Prod.mk_le_mk, hB, and_self, f])
  refine ⟨i, j - i, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have he : f (j - i + n) = f n := by
    induction n, hn using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => simpa only [Nat.sub_add_cancel hij.le] using heq.symm
    | succ n hn ih =>
      have hnew := (hu (j - i + n + 4) (Nat.le_add_left _ _)).1.trans
        ((congrArg (fun (a, b, c, d) =>
          ((d : ℝ) + c + b * a) / (d * c + b + a)) ih).trans
            (hu (n + 4) (Nat.le_add_left _ _)).1.symm)
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, f] at ih ⊢
      exact ⟨ih.2.1, ih.2.2.1, ih.2.2.2, Int.cast_injective hnew⟩
  simpa only [Nat.add_comm] using congrArg Prod.fst he

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  simp only [← Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.not] at *
  apply Nat.mul_left_cancel Nat.two_pos
  rw [mul_pow_sub_one Fintype.card_ne_zero, ← Fintype.card_set,
    ← Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq hPP]
  grind [Set.Intersecting]

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h i
  have hr (a b : Fin 9 → ℤ) (h : relation a b) (j : Fin 9) :
      7 ∣ b j * 10 ^ j.1 - a j * 10 ^ j.1 + digits_to_num a := by
    convert ((hrelation a b).mp h).2 j using 1
    symm
    rw [← sub_eq_iff_eq_add, hdigits_to_num, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [ite_mul, ite_sub, sub_self,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  have hs := Finset.dvd_sum (fun j (_ : j ∈ Finset.univ) => hr d e h.1 j)
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Int.nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat,
    ← congrFun hdigits_to_num e, ← congrFun hdigits_to_num d] at hs
  have he : 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d := by omega
  have hi := dvd_add (hr e f h.2 i) (hr d e h.1 i)
  rw [add_add_add_comm, sub_add_sub_cancel, dvd_add_left he] at hi
  apply ((show IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 from ⟨3, -2, rfl⟩).pow_right
    (n := i.1)).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  rwa [sub_mul, dvd_sub_comm]
